theme: An open day in St. Pete, with one early call to prep for tomorrow.
greeting: Nothing is on the calendar today, Dan, so the day is genuinely yours. The thing that earns some of it is prep for tomorrow's 7:30 ICGN planning call — plus a couple of holiday-travel bookings that are well past due.

needsAttention.title: Read the ICGN Plenary 7 session outline
needsAttention.detail: Tomorrow's 7:30 AM planning call for the Toronto conference asks everyone to review the attached session outline beforehand so you arrive ready to discuss the stewardship-data deep dive.

needsAttention.title: Book the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Your top-priority task to reserve a full-size SUV out of Portland for Christmas week is long overdue. It's the hardest rental in that market over the holidays — a refundable booking held now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December break plan
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by and book-by dates for the all-four-kids December trip have both passed. Holiday inventory for six, over three weeks, is the thinnest of the year — pick domestic or flexible-international and commit.

flagged.title: LinkedIn note from Hans-Kristian Bryn
flagged.detail: A message from Hans-Kristian Bryn has been waiting a few days — worth a reply if it's a networking thread.

flagged.title: NACD New England run of show
flagged.detail: The run of show for next Wednesday's NACD New England event (Oct 28) arrived; you're on the participant list.

flagged.title: Valoris / FinCity call moved to Nov 5
flagged.detail: An updated invite sets the Valoris Stewardship Catalysts x IMC/FinCity call for Nov 5, 7–8 AM ET.

inbox.noise: The rest is Apple receipts, hotel-points offers, and LinkedIn/Facebook digests — nothing needing you.

recipe.title: Vin santo–roasted pears
recipe.why: Peak pear season calls for something unhurried — pears slow-roasted in sweet wine, the kind of autumn dessert that perfumes the kitchen while the evening settles.

acts.line: The calendar is clear straight through — your first fixed commitment is tomorrow morning.
An open, unbroken stretch: the kind of day to spend on what's been pushed down the list.
Tomorrow opens at 7:30, so tonight tilts toward an earlier wind-down.
